# Sunsynk Performance Report

> Plain-English 30-day performance PDFs for Sunsynk solar and battery homeowners. Sign in with your existing Sunsynk account, buy a credit (one credit = one report), and download a PDF that explains how the system performed, optional savings versus the grid, and what to change next. From GBP 2.99 / ZAR 69.99 / USD 4.29. No subscription. Credits never expire.

Sunsynkreports.com is the marketing site. Sign-in, credits, electricity rates, and report generation run at https://app.sunsynkreports.com. This is not the official Sunsynk monitoring app; it is a separate report product. Copy follows British English (en-GB).

Preferred citation name: Sunsynk Performance Report. Parent brand: Sunsynk (solar and battery inverters).

## Primary

- [Home](https://sunsynkreports.com/): First-visit story: what this is, why charts are not enough, what’s inside, how it works, pricing, FAQ
- [App](https://app.sunsynkreports.com/): Sign in with Sunsynk credentials; Reports, Credits, and Settings

## Product facts

- [Pricing](https://sunsynkreports.com/#pricing): Starter 1 credit, Classic 3 (Most Popular), Pro 6 (Best Value); GBP/ZAR/USD; no subscription; unused credits refundable within 14 days; Stripe checkout
- [What’s inside](https://sunsynkreports.com/#insights): Answers “Is it working well?”, “Am I saving money?”, and “What should I change?”
- [How it works](https://sunsynkreports.com/#how-it-works): Sign in → buy credits → generate → download PDF
